card.name: Final egg maturation and hCG trigger
card.fires_on: Words in fertility-treatment text about stopping FSH dosing and triggering final oocyte maturation with hCG, such as 'final', 'and', 'hCG', and 'follicular'. It also fires weakly on a few stray spots in other dosing or timing text.

modes.label: Trigger of final maturation
modes.description: Words just before or inside the 'final maturation of the oocytes' phrase after FSH dosing stops.
modes.example: dosing of FOLLISTIM AQ Cartridge is stopped and<< final>> maturation of the oocytes is induced

modes.label: hCG administration
modes.description: The 'CG' piece of hCG when it is followed by administration or a dose.
modes.example: Treatment with ganirelix acetate should be continued daily until the day of h<<CG>> administration.

modes.label: Stray timing text
modes.description: Occasional words in other timing or dosing sentences, such as stopping drugs before skin testing.
modes.example: Topical steroids should be discontinued at the skin test site for<< at>> least 2-3 weeks before skin

card.plain: It lights up when fertility-drug text describes stopping the stimulating drug and giving hCG to finish egg maturation.
